product_from_film: Pocket is a small recording device presented with call and live-conversation modes, speaker recognition, action items, summaries and conversation maps.
explains_well: Close views isolate the record button and mode switch, then show the kinds of outputs the recording can produce.
unclear: No specific recorded conversation is traced into its transcript and summary, so the output cards remain illustrative.
scenario: Record a call or conversation and turn it into organized notes and follow-up items.
product_clear_basis: AI powered recording device is visible around 11s; record and mode controls immediately follow.

sound.detail: The draft supports an introduction, named colors, phone attachment, storage/open-source claims and a preorder offer. The central graphic segment has no useful draft speech; that is not proof of silence. Some storage wording is incomplete. Delivery, music, effects and sync were not heard.

categories.finding: Reveal hardware → controls → outputs → specifications → presenter and offer.
Presenter invitation leads into dark close-ups that conceal then reveal the device.
The recording-device label and large physical controls explain the category by 13s.
Button/switch views, checked-card states and branching map states explain functions; exact movement timing unverified.
Hardware close-ups give way to output cards and return to hardware before the presenter.
Blue highlights on black create product contrast; the bright presenter room provides a warmer physical reference.
Mode names and feature labels are large; longer summary text and template details are denser.
Partial ASR supports presenter claims but not heard delivery; the middle segment lacks useful transcript text.
Music character and structure are unverified.
Effects and their sources are unverified.

categories.finding: Controls and output categories are readable without sound; the later presenter-only stretch relies on speech.
Large close-ups direct attention to one control at a time before widening to device variants.
A compact graphic demonstration occupies roughly 6–45s; the latter half repeats or expands the offer through presenter footage.
Recording controls lead to plausible output examples, but the same source conversation is not shown.
Metallic-looking detail and physical handling may suggest a tangible premium object; audience response unmeasured.
The same slim device links close-ups, phone attachment, colors and hand-held scale.
Speaker recognition, battery life, privacy, open-source scope, storage, export behavior and current preorder price are unverified film claims.
Physical mode and record controls distinguish this from a software-only note-taking demo.
Trace one short recording into an output.
